overall_goal: Boil water and prepare ingredients and tools for making couscous

goals.description: Fill the kettle with water and turn it on to boil
goals.rationale: The person fills the kettle with tap water, places it on the counter, and plugs it in to start boiling.

goals.description: Prepare the measuring cups, couscous, and boiled water for mixing
goals.rationale: The person gathers measuring cups, reads the couscous instructions, retrieves the kettle with boiled water, and opens the couscous bag to prepare for measuring.
